//: CONVENTIONS rule 8 ledger — the written justification for every workspace dependency (runtime OR dev). Surfaced at milestone exit for the 30-second G-M owner glance (decision 0051/F44). Internal @ingame/* packages are auto-justified. Format: name → why needed · why no stdlib/existing path · provenance.
typescript: The language + tsc typecheck/build (CI six-check steps 1 & 6). No stdlib equivalent. Provenance: Microsoft.
tsx: Run TS entrypoints (dev server, db:migrate, db:reset, drizzle scripts) without a build step. Avoids a compile-to-JS dance in M1. Provenance: privatenumber/esbuild.
typescript-eslint: TypeScript-aware ESLint integration + recommended rules (lint step). Provenance: typescript-eslint org.
eslint: The general-quality linter (CI six-check step 1; the InGame [LINT] rules are custom in tools/lint). Provenance: ESLint org.
@eslint/js: ESLint's official recommended JS ruleset for the flat config. Provenance: ESLint org.
globals: Canonical global-identifier sets for the ESLint flat config (node/browser). Provenance: sindresorhus.
eslint-config-prettier: Turns off ESLint rules that conflict with Prettier so formatting + linting don't fight. Provenance: Prettier org.
prettier: Code formatter — one consistent style across the monorepo. Provenance: Prettier org.
vitest: Unit + integration test runner (CI six-check steps 2 & 3); first-class ESM/TS + Vite resolution for the workspace packages. Provenance: Vitest org.
@types/node: Node type definitions for the server + tooling. Provenance: DefinitelyTyped.
zod: The single executable FE↔BE contract — request/response schemas (CONVENTIONS rule 3, decision 0046 #1). Provenance: colinhacks.
express: The HTTP server framework for the API (product-spec §9, decision 0046 #2). Provenance: expressjs.
drizzle-orm: Typed SQL + the data-access layer; SQL-transparent + testable (decision 0046 #2/#7). Provenance: Drizzle team.
drizzle-kit: Generates + journals the committed migrations (decision 0046 #7; F28 journal check). Provenance: Drizzle team.
pg: PostgreSQL driver backing drizzle node-postgres. Provenance: brianc/node-postgres.
supertest: HTTP assertions against the Express app at the boundary — the integration heart (testing-strategy §2). Provenance: ladjs.
testcontainers: Throwaway real-Postgres containers so integration tests run against a real DB, not mocks (testing-strategy §2; F36). Provenance: Testcontainers org.
@testcontainers/postgresql: The Postgres module for Testcontainers (the integration PG container). Provenance: Testcontainers org.
expo: The Expo SDK — the React Native app platform + the Chrome/web dev loop + iPhone path (decision 0046 #2; item 7). Provenance: Expo.
expo-router: File-based navigation for the Expo client (product-spec §9). Provenance: Expo.
expo-status-bar: Status-bar component pulled in by the Expo app template. Provenance: Expo.
react: The UI runtime underpinning React Native. Provenance: Meta.
react-dom: React web renderer — required for the Expo web (Chrome) dev/test loop. Provenance: Meta.
react-native: The native client runtime (iOS/Android) (decision 0046 #2). Provenance: Meta.
react-native-web: Renders React Native components on web — the Chrome dev/test convenience surface (item 7). Provenance: Necolas.
react-native-safe-area-context: Safe-area insets dependency required by expo-router. Provenance: th3rdwave.
react-native-screens: Native screen primitives required by expo-router navigation. Provenance: Software Mansion.
@reduxjs/toolkit: State management + RTK Query (server cache) bound to the shared zod types (decision 0046 #2; F31). Provenance: Redux team.
react-redux: React bindings for Redux Toolkit. Provenance: Redux team.
jest-expo: The Jest preset for Expo/React Native component tests (RNTL) — the client test runner (testing-strategy §2). Provenance: Expo.
jest: Test runner backing jest-expo for the RN component layer. Provenance: Meta.
@testing-library/react-native: Behavior-focused RN component testing (testing-strategy §2). Provenance: Testing Library.
react-test-renderer: React renderer used by RNTL/jest-expo to render components in tests. Provenance: Meta.
@types/react: React type definitions for the TS client. Provenance: DefinitelyTyped.
@types/jest: Jest type definitions for the client component tests. Provenance: DefinitelyTyped.
@babel/core: Babel core required by the Expo/Metro + jest-expo transform pipeline. Provenance: Babel.
